title: Anglo-Egyptian Slave Trade Convention
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anglo-Egyptian Slave Trade Convention", at revision 1381888423, opens: "The Anglo-Egyptian Slave Trade Convention, also known as Anglo-Egyptian Convention for the Suppression of the Slave Trade or Anglo-Egyptian Convention for the Abolition of Slavery, was a treaty between the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the Khedivate of Egypt from 1877. The first version of 1877 was followed by an addition in 1884 and a second addition in 1895. It formally banned the slave trade to Egypt. While slavery itself was not abolished, existing slaves were granted the right to apply for manumission, which managed to phase out slavery by the early 20th-century." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q115762235, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty between the United Kingdom and the Khedivate of Egypt". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
